text: anyone know what they CBA ask in interview

from 5 shared experiences, cba interviews were mostly projects + dsa + behavioral
sql came up in 3, os and cloud in 2
dsa was mostly medium, with one hard dp (knapsack variant) in an iit hyderabad round
do prepare your resume projects well, they dig into design choices

Gave this OA recently? Do reply and correct me, helpful reply gets the coins on this question 🪙
